description.text: This program is divided into beginner, intermediate and advanced levels with each level further divided into 3 levels to allow students at similar Chinese levels to be grouped together. Each class consists of 10-18 students. The curriculum focuses on listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, modern grammar and essay writing.

duration.text: The Elementary Chinese Training Program at University of International Business and Economics is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.Certificate of employment or education Students still at school should provide school attendance certificate, graduates who have a job should provide working certificate. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be in good health 2.High school diploma 3.Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial deed of guardianship
